snapshot_note: Findings refer to the source read and fixture reproductions before any later root repair; reviewer did not edit root files.

findings.issue: daily/weekly/monthly fixed-time values are classified as relative and arbitrary resolved overrides are accepted.
findings.proof: Frozen expected schedule=daily 08:00; override and authoritative record schedule=daily 09:00; score_task_request returned score=1,status=pass.
findings.implication: Explicit user time can be replaced by the observed result, producing a false positive.
findings.recommendation: Preserve fixed time/day components. Permit representational normalization only from a canonical source/time resolver with independent origin; reject conflicting daily 09:00 as unknown or use the fixed 08:00 predicate.

findings.issue: Old initial artifacts are excluded only when final path matches the original inventory key.
findings.proof: initial_sha256={'old.txt':sha}; renamed.txt is a byte-for-byte copy of old.txt; final binding renamed.txt with allow_existing_file_reference=false returned score=1 and no provenance_rejections.
findings.implication: Renaming/copying an unchanged old artifact satisfies a new output obligation.
findings.recommendation: Compare current candidate SHA against initial inventory values as well as declared input values, with the explicit existing-reference exception retained.

findings.issue: Inventory dictionaries are type-checked but their digest values are not validated.
findings.proof: declared_input_sha256={'old.txt':'invalid_digest'} with a copied file returned score=1.
findings.implication: Malformed measurement data silently acts as an empty valid inventory rather than UNSCORED.
findings.recommendation: Validate digest encoding and the known inventory value schema; malformed inventories are UnknownEvidence before provenance comparison.

findings.issue: A prefilled original_job_id skips real initial-snapshot verification.
findings.proof: Transition claimed original_job_id with no actual initial snapshot file; enrich_same_job_identity preserved the claim.
findings.implication: Missing real before-dispatch identity evidence need not remain unknown.
findings.recommendation: Verify any retained original_job_id against the actual hashed native initial snapshot, or only retain a separately verified provenance binding; do not accept an unproven prefilled ID.

findings.issue: Engine loading occurs before the measurement try block; failure rendering also calls load_engine.
findings.proof: Controlled import failure during pinned engine load escaped score_task_request as ImportError.
findings.implication: Missing/corrupt implementation dependency can crash the CLI instead of returning UNSCORED.
findings.recommendation: Wrap engine load as a measurement failure and make frozen-row failure rendering merge parameters locally without reloading the unavailable engine.

passed_scope_observations: Observed missing/blank ordinary mandatory deliveries produce 0; absence of required independent evidence produces UNSCORED.
Mandatory failures use AND; explicitly nonmandatory observations do not enter the score.
Source identity and complete-conversation flags are required; file paths remain inside the current workspace.
Selected-skill reference resolution is mandatory and tied to the actual previous new answer SHA; unresolved selections remain hard unknown.
No historical AI content was read in this review; source code, controlled metadata and current local fixture bytes only.

own_extension_cross_layer_correction.issue: PDF no-table observation returned scorable:false but lacked runtime's applicable:false flag, so the row was presented as pass.
own_extension_cross_layer_correction.action: Corrected only _extensions.py to return applicable as well; added a PDF runtime integration regression in our own test file.
own_extension_cross_layer_correction.result: 41 own controls pass; PDF row is not_applicable with passed:null and scorable:false; mandatory PDF file delivery still governs the task.

final_distinct_artifact_objects.values: IDs are unique nonempty strings; count is a positive int, not bool. Resolve reviewed delivery_indices to actual delivery IDs.

final_artifact_parent_directory.values: directory_label is a nonempty string. Independent directory_binding label/path/source/authoritative/frozen-origin evidence is required.

final_native_document_no_tables.values: Only report_only. Actual non-DOCX outputs have scorable:false,applicable:false; DOCX native tables are checked.

final_service_state.source_job_id_scope: Only final_service_state with service cron_registration; otherwise UnknownEvidence. Without source_job_id delegate unchanged to the base handler.
